title: Design for the ERC
lede: Web pages in Claude Design, flyers and posts in Canva, and what changes for print.

slides.cap: The Aggie Web Template is Texas A&M's web design system, for web pages. For flyers and posts, use Canva.

steps.title: Start a web page
items: The first time, open the Aggie Web Template link in the email.
In Claude Design, say "use the Aggie Web Template design system".

slides.cap: Aggie Maroon carries most of a design.

steps.title: First time only: the Brand Kit
items: Add each color in the table under these slides by its HEX.

slides.cap: Fonts: Oswald for big titles in capitals, Work Sans for headings, Open Sans for body.

notes.html: Never redraw, recolor or stretch a logo.
Put a logo only on white or maroon.

steps.title: Logos
items: Download the ERC logo pack for screens and unzip it.
Upload the logos in it to Canva.
steps.links: ERC logo pack for screens

slides.cap: In print, Aggie Maroon is CMYK 15 100 39 69, Pantone 7421.

steps.title: Before it goes to the printer
items: Use the ERC logo pack for print.
Set body text at 11 point or larger.
From Canva, download as PDF Print, with bleed if the printer asks.
steps.links: ERC logo pack for print
